name: Cherry Lin
source:
A close friend of both Sami and Umi, Cherry is the long-suffering mediator between the two, and finds that her thankless job grows more stressful by the day.

It's not like she can even put this on her resume!

[From [url=http://www.stardust-soda.com/through-the-panels/]official website[/url]]

Born in 1996.
Hometown: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
